name: Return to Sven
summary: You bring Jitters' finished journal to Sven Yorgen's camp near Westfall. Its pages may answer the questions that have haunted him since his family's murder.

sections.title: A Coward's Confession
sections.body: When Sven Yorgen's farm came under attack, Jitters fled into the woods and left an incomplete diary behind. Afraid of Sven's anger and haunted by what he had seen, he hid deep in Duskwood. When you find him, he willingly gives you his finished journal. He hopes the full account will spare him from facing Sven in person.

sections.title: Unmasking the Dark Riders
sections.body: Jitters' finished account explains why the Dark Riders killed Sven's family. They sought an artifact, rather than striking in a random undead surge or an attack by feral beasts. Sven also remembers those same hooded figures meeting in secret with the necromancer Morbent Fel near the Forlorn Rowe. Now his blind sorrow has become a hunt for retribution against Morbent Fel.

faq.q: Why is Jitters so terrified of Sven Yorgen?
faq.answer: Jitters fled Sven's farm and fears facing the grieving farmer's anger. He asks you to carry his journal to Sven so he can read the account.

faq.q: What is in Jitters' completed journal?
faq.answer: Jitters' finished journal gives his full account of what happened at Sven's farm. Sven needs to read it to understand what happened to his family.

faq.q: Who are the Dark Riders mentioned by Sven?
faq.answer: The Dark Riders are mysterious, hooded figures who roam Duskwood. They seek powerful magical relics and leave death and ruin behind them.

faq.q: How is Morbent Fel connected to the attack on Sven's farm?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel is a powerful necromancer in western Duskwood. Sven's investigation and Jitters' journal reveal his connection to the attack.

faq.q: Where can Sven Yorgen be found?
faq.answer: Sven has left his ruined farmstead for a small camp in Duskwood's northwestern hills, near the border crossing into Westfall.

faq.q: What happens after giving Sven the journal?
aliases: next quest after return to sven
faq.answer: After reading Jitters' account, Sven asks you to prove your combat abilities in Proving Your Worth.

angles.text: The destruction of Yorgen Farmstead shows Stormwind's failure to protect Duskwood's frontier settlements from the encroaching shadows.
As a paladin, you help Sven uncover the forces behind his family's murder. Your holy duty calls you to protect the innocent and seek justice.
